description: Only tracks whose file size is strictly greater than 10,323,804 bytes are included.

b.request: For each media type, calculate the average bytes-per-millisecond ratio (Bytes ÷ Milliseconds) among only those tracks with Bytes strictly greater than 10,323,804, then return the unrounded simple average of those per-media-type averages.
b.sql: SELECT AVG(media_type_avg) as result FROM (SELECT MediaTypeId, AVG(Bytes * 1.0 / Milliseconds) as media_type_avg FROM Track WHERE Bytes > 10323804 GROUP BY MediaTypeId) subquery
b.raw: For each media type, calculate the average bytes-per-millisecond ratio (Bytes ÷ Milliseconds) among only those tracks with Bytes strictly greater than 10,323,804, then return the unrounded simple average of those per-media-type averages.

d.request: For tracks with `Bytes` strictly greater than 10,323,804, calculate the average of (bytes per millisecond) separately for each media type by name, then return the arithmetic mean of those per-media-type averages as a single unrounded value.
d.sql: SELECT AVG(media_avg) as result FROM (SELECT AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS DECIMAL) / CAST(t.Milliseconds AS DECIMAL)) as media_avg FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes > 10323804 GROUP BY m.Name) subquery

a.request: Considering only tracks whose file size (`Track.Bytes`) is more than 10,323,804 bytes, work out for each media type (by name) the average bytes per millisecond (`Bytes` ÷ `Milliseconds`) of its tracks. What is the simple average of these per-media-type averages? Return just that single value, unrounded.
a.sql:
WITH media_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    m.Name,
    AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS FLOAT) / t.Milliseconds) as media_avg
  FROM Track t
  JOIN MediaType m ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId
  WHERE t.Bytes > 10323804
  GROUP BY m.Name
)
SELECT AVG(media_avg) as result
FROM media_averages

c.request: Considering only tracks that pass a file-size (`Track.Bytes`) cutoff of 10,323,804 bytes, work out for each media type (by name) the average bytes per millisecond (`Bytes` ÷ `Milliseconds`) of its tracks. What is the simple average of these per-media-type averages? Return just that single value, unrounded. Only tracks whose file size is strictly greater than 10,323,804 bytes are included.
c.sql: SELECT AVG(avg_bytes_per_ms) FROM (SELECT AVG(1.0 * t.Bytes / t.Milliseconds) as avg_bytes_per_ms FROM Track t JOIN MediaType mt ON t.MediaTypeId = mt.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes > 10323804 GROUP BY mt.Name) AS subquery
